versions.changelog:
- Improved skill documentation for managing the full lifecycle of CloudRobo robot instances.
- Clarified usage scenarios, workflows, and architecture for registering, querying, updating, deleting, and exporting robot certificates.
- Added detailed workflows for robot registration, management, metadata updates, and secure certificate export.
- Included guidance for both natural language and CLI/SDK usage.
- Outlined differences between robot access config (certificate) and body/main config for secure onboarding.
- Enhanced prerequisite and security information for safe and effective robot onboarding.
